name: godot
description: Build Godot 4 games with Claude Code: the godot MCP server drives the Godot editor and the running game, a hook checks every GDScript file that Claude writes, and a skill describes the workflow.

godot_path.title: Godot executable
godot_path.description: The Godot 4 editor executable, such as /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot. Leave it empty when Godot is on PATH or in its standard location, or when you open the project in the Godot editor yourself.
